## Scaling every component {#iv2-scaling .component-lesson .vector-lesson}

Multiply each component by the same scalar.

<div data-components="scaling"></div>
<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Section 3.3 · p. 20</div>

::: notes
Use a=(2,1). The slider and presets include negative, fractional and zero values. For k>0 direction is unchanged; k<0 reverses direction; k=0 is the zero vector with no direction. Equal axis scales make the geometric length change meaningful. The original vector is shown as a dotted reference when its multiple overlaps it.
:::
